meta.label: Years of rent to equal the purchase price by comune (2025H2)
meta.source: Agenzia delle Entrate — Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare (OMI)
meta.methodNote: Purchase €/m² divided by twelve months' rent per m², averaged across that comune's own OMI zones. A ratio between two published OMI prices, not a yield or a payback period: it ignores purchase taxes, IMU, maintenance, financing and vacancy. OMI semester 2025H2. Comuni without both a purchase and a rent figure are absent, never estimated.
